name: Finance-group verified LINE mention
requiresDatabases: HOZO AM 2.0 Group Bindings with one finance binding and a valid 成員對照 JSON field

dataIsolation.guard: The caller supplies neither groupId nor userId. The route resolves both only inside the HOZO AM 2.0 tenant and reads mention identity solely from the uniquely selected finance binding page.

definitionOfDone: The finance push body requires a bounded mentionName present in text
Finance retryKey is required, fixed-format, and cryptographically bound to the normalized payload
Caller-supplied groupId, userId, and unsupported fields are rejected
The finance binding is selected by exact canonical name across all Notion result pages
Exactly one member-map entry on the selected finance binding resolves the mention
Duplicate JSON keys plus missing, malformed, invalid, and ambiguous member mappings return non-2xx without a LINE push
The existing LINE sender receives the resolved mention object and produces textV2
Responses and logs do not expose the resolved LINE user id
A LINE 409 is delivered only with accepted-request evidence for the same content-bound payload
Rental records non-2xx or non-delivered results as notification failure
